citations.quote: The police arrested the suspect behind the shooting of a 23-year-old woman while she was hosting a livestreaming video online last January 16 in Barangay Sta.

The Taytay Municipal Police Station said the victim was shot on the head by the suspect who was wearing a face mask and a ballcap.

The victim slumped over instantly and was rushed by witnesses to the nearest hospital, having sustained a grazing bullet wound to the nape, the police added.
The 31-year-old suspect was immediately arrested the following day, January 17, in the town of Angono.
Investigation showed he was a former live-in partner of the victim’s employer.
“Napag-alaman ng pulisya na ang suspek ay dating kinakasama ng may-ari ng tindahan kung saan nagtatrabaho ang biktima.

Ang 'di pagkakaunawaan ng suspek at kanyang kinakasama na nauwi sa hiwalayan ay ‘di umano’y mula sa mga pagsusumbong ng biktima kaugnay sa mga nakaka relasyon pang iba ng suspek,” the Taytay Municipal Police Station said.
(Police investigation revealed that the suspect is the former partner of the store owner where the victim is employed.

The dispute between the suspect and his partner, which led to their breakup, was allegedly triggered by the victim reporting the suspect’s other romantic involvements.)

“Dahil sa hiwalayan, nagparte parte ng ari-arian ang dating magkarelasyon, at ang pag-iintindi sa tindahan ay pinamamahalaan na mismo ng biktima na siyang ‘di matanggap ng suspek kaya nagawa niya ang nasabing insidente.”
(Following the separation, the former couple divided their assets, and the management of the store was handed over to the victim.

The suspect was reportedly unable to accept this arrangement, which drove him to commit the act.)

The suspect is now detained at the Taytay Municipal Police Station Custodial Facility and is facing charges of frustrated murder.
